variants.name: default
variants.what: 160 B23 (0.25 m), grounded spring k x tributary length at every node

variants.name: b21
variants.what: 400 shear-flexible B21 (0.1 m), element moments extrapolated to the load

variants.name: ip_reported
variants.what: default model, the largest integration-point moment reported (0.25 m cubic elements: 2 % below the nodal value)

variants.name: mesh_1m
variants.what: 40 B23 (1 m) with springs every 1 m, the moment extrapolated to the load node by Abaqus reported (2 % below Hetenyi)

variants.name: half_symmetry
variants.what: half the beam with symmetry at the load, P/2

variants.name: foundation_keyword
variants.what: *FOUNDATION on the beam elements instead of springs

variants.name: ks_no_width
variants.what: subgrade modulus not multiplied by the beam width: deflection +15 %, moment +5 %

variants.name: spring_no_spacing
variants.what: nodal springs not multiplied by the 0.25 m node spacing: foundation 4 times too stiff

variants.name: coarse_mesh
variants.what: 2 m elements and springs every 2 m: the moment at the load node is 9 % low

variants.name: b21_ip_reported
variants.what: 160 B21 (0.25 m), the largest element moment reported: one value per linear element, 8 % below the moment at the load point

variants.name: fake_report
variants.what: correct ODB, deflection reported in mm
